name: Runic Prophecy
description:
About This Game

Runic Prophecy is a third-person, soulslike action RPG set in the shattered world of Eyjusheim.

Once a mighty and prosperous kingdom, Eyjusheim now lingers as a shadow of its former self. A cataclysmic event brought the empire to its knees, tearing it apart along with its legendary dragon lords. All that remains are scattered islands drifting through an endless void, remnants of a world that once was.

Will you, alongside your dragon companion, have the strength to restore Eyjusheim to its former glory and reignite a shattered world?

Destructible Environments: Use your sword, bow, or just roll into objects to shatter them. Unleash the raw power of your dragon to bring some constructions and defense systems crashing down.

Ride Your Dragon into Battle: Soar into combat on the back of your mighty dragon, bringing death from above with its elemental breath. Turn the tide of battle with devastating aerial assaults.

Challenging Boss Fights: Face off against dreaded lords and ancient monstrosities in relentless battles that will test your skill, timing, and strategy. Learn their patterns and exploit their weaknesses to emerge victorious.

Runes: While exploring the shattered world of Eyjusheim, you will uncover ancient runes, stone fragments imbued with immense powers. Some will enhance your strength, while others grant you the ability to cast devastating spells.

Build Your Own Character: Craft a hero that matches your playstyle. Will you become a fearless dragon knight or a mighty archer? It's up to you.
short_desc: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.
